payload.name: Reciprocity in socially bonded pairs
payload.fact: Socially bonded pairs exhibit a form of reciprocity that is neither immediate nor strictly enforced, which contributes to the evolutionary stability of helping behaviors.
payload.boundary: Game theory model of social bonds and helping behavior.

provenance.title: Social bond dynamics and the evolution of helping
provenance.quote_or_locus: We find that there is reciprocity in socially bonded pairs, which is neither immediate nor very strict, and that relatively small social neighbourhoods are required for the evolutionary stability of helping
